Name: Abjurers Gilder
Description: While worn by a wizard who knows shield, the shield spell is always prepared without counting against prepared spells. Whenever you cast shield, you gain one additional reaction before the start of your next turn; that extra reaction cannot be used to cast shield again.

Name: Adventurer's Ring
Description: A practical magical ring intended to provide a small benefit to an adventurer.

Name: Aereni Mask
Description: A magical mask associated with Aereni traditions and appearance.

Name: Alcoholock
Description: This tankard-shaped lock cannot be picked with thieves' tools or opened by a key. It opens only when at least 1 ounce of its bound alcoholic drink is poured into the keyhole. Binding takes 1 hour of submersion; a DC 15 Wisdom (Perception) check identifies the drink by smell, increasing by 2 for each additional alcohol in a blend, to a maximum DC 25.

Name: Amulet of Beginner's Luck
Description: When you make an ability check using a skill you are not proficient in and roll a 1 or 2 on the d20, you can reroll the check and must use the new result. Once used, this property recharges at the next dawn.

Name: Armor of Gleaming
Description: Armor that magically keeps a polished, spotless appearance.

Name: Aurora Dust
Description: The bag contains 1d6 + 4 pinches. As an action, sprinkle a pinch over an open flame to recolor its light blue, green, and purple and create a shimmering aurora above it within the bright-light area. The effect lasts as long as the flame, up to 24 hours.

Name: Bag of Bellstones
Description: The bag holds up to 20 small stones and is typically found with 1d12 + 8. A stone kept inside for at least 1 minute becomes magical until the end of your turn when removed; while magical, it rings like a bell audible to 60 feet whenever it hits a target or touches a surface.

Name: Ball of Wild Earth
Description: A Tiny sentient pebble covered in shapeable dirt. It rolls at 10 feet, has AC 10, 15 hit points, resistance to all damage, and regains all hit points after being buried underground for 1 hour. It can reshape its dirt into small forms and understands Common and Terran; it has hearing and 60-foot darkvision.

Name: Bands of the Found and Lost
Description: Magical bands that help locate, recover, or reconnect separated objects or creatures.

Name: Bard in a Box
Description: A tiny magical performer that can provide music and bardic-style entertainment.

Name: Bath Potion
Description: A magical potion centered on bathing and cleanliness, providing a whimsical magical bathing effect rather than combat power.

Name: Battle Rod
Description: A magical rod designed to provide a minor combat-oriented benefit.

Name: Bead of Nourishment
Description: A small magical bead that provides nourishment when consumed.

Name: Bead of Refreshment
Description: A small bead that magically provides a refreshing drink.

Name: Bell of Alarm
Description: The clapperless bell has 4 charges. As an action, expend 1 charge and specify a delay of up to 8 hours; when time expires, only you hear its ringing if you are within 1 mile and on the same plane. You can cancel a timer mentally as a bonus action. All charges return at dawn.

Name: Belltower Triangle
Description: As an action, strike the triangle; it rings until the start of your next turn and is audible to 120 feet. Any creature that hears it magically knows the current time of day to the nearest quarter hour. The property recharges at midday or midnight, whichever comes first.

Name: Belt of Honesty
Description: A magical belt associated with truthfulness and honest communication.

Name: Bird of a Feather
Description: A magical bird-themed item that creates a connection between creatures or objects sharing a common nature.

Name: Bird's-Eye Bolt
Description: As an action, fire this magic arrow or bolt upward to destroy it and create an invisible sensor in a space you can see up to 120 feet directly above you. For 1 minute, or until you move more than 120 feet from the firing point, you can use an action to see and hear through the sensor until the start of your next turn. If the ammunition hits a target instead, it loses its magic.

Name: Bloody Marilith
Description: After drinking the common version, for 1 minute you can take one reaction even if you have already used a reaction since the end of your last turn; taking that extra reaction ends the effect. Drinking additional Bloody Mariliths before a long rest causes lethargy when the effect ends, preventing movement or actions until after your next turn.

Name: Bonfire Blade
Description: As an action, jab this sword into the ground at your feet. It sinks to the hilt and creates a small magical campfire that gives normal heat and light but needs no fuel or oxygen and produces no smoke. An action removes the sword harmlessly and leaves no trace of the fire.

Name: Bonfire Candle
Description: Its flame gives light like a normal candle and keeps every creature within that light at a comfortably warm temperature.

Name: Bonfire Charm
Description: Place the charm on a burning campfire or torch to give the fire a faint healing radiance. Friendly creatures within its light that spend one or more Hit Dice at the end of a short rest treat each Hit Die roll of 1 as a 2.

Name: Book of Instant Copying
Description: A magical book that can rapidly copy written information.

Name: Boots of False Tracks
Description: Boots that magically obscure or alter the tracks left by their wearer.

Name: Borbos Joyous Wand of Color
Description: A wand that produces cheerful magical colors and visual effects.

Name: Borbos's Marvelous Magic Marker (Common)
Description: This self-inking marker can replace ink and a quill, and its ink color can be changed as a bonus action. Once per dawn, you can triple-click it to make the brush erase ink for up to 1 minute instead, removing up to 1 square foot of ink containing no more than 150 characters or 25 words.

Name: Bubble Collar
Description: While worn underwater, the collar creates a breathable bubble around your head for up to 10 minutes, allowing normal speech. The bubble ends early if you take damage, leave the water, or remove the collar, and cannot form again until the collar has spent at least 1 minute out of water.

Name: Bubbling Bathbombs
Description: Common bathbombs usually come in sets of 5. Dropping one into a filled tub or similar vessel turns the water into an aromatic bubbling bath at a perfect temperature for 1 hour or until emptied. Rare versions add a themed benefit after a creature soaks for at least 10 minutes.

Name: Bulletin Buckler
Description: As an action, speak the shield's command word to make 1d4 illusory local job postings appear on it, drawn from public signs within 1 mile. The postings last until the next dawn or until the job is completed. This property can be used once per dawn.

Name: Bullfrog Totem
Description: A frog-themed magical totem that provides a minor amphibian or jumping-related benefit.

Name: Calling Cans
Description: A pair of cans can be linked by tapping them together. While holding one, use an action to wrap it with at least 6 inches of copper wire and speak into it; your voice is duplicated from its linked can if the two are within 120 feet. The wire turns to ash after use.

Name: Campers Crutch
Description: A magical walking aid designed to help travelers and campers move, rest, and maintain camp.

Name: Campfire Cord
Description: This 1-pound magical log is never consumed by fire and stays cool when removed. In a fire, its cracks act as a clock and sound again at the start of each hour; glowing ember-lines also form musical notation that produces a soft tune adapting to the local scenery and conversation.

Name: Candle of the Deep
Description: A candle enchanted to continue providing light even underwater.

Name: Candleflame Helm
Description: While wearing the helm, use a bonus action to create or extinguish a flame above your head. It starts with 15 feet of bright light and 15 more feet of dim light; as an action you can change each radius by 5 feet, from 10 to 30 feet. The flame ends if the helm is removed or you are incapacitated.

Name: Candy Xorn
Description: These candies usually come in bags of 2d6 + 3. Eating one changes your eyes to orange or yellow with reptilian pupils for 1 minute. Each candy has a 5% chance to actually be a coated gemstone: usually eye agate or tiger's eye worth 10 gp, or rarely amber worth 100 gp.

Name: Cast-Off Armor
Description: Armor enchanted so the wearer can remove it almost instantly.

Name: Catnip Amulet
Description: While wearing this amulet, you have advantage on checks made to find or call Tiny domestic cats, if any are nearby, and on Wisdom (Animal Handling) checks made to interact with them.

Name: Celestial Sunrise Potion (Common)
Description: The common potion makes light shine from your mouth for 1 hour in a 20-foot cone of bright light plus 20 feet of dim light. The uncommon version instead lasts 8 hours, lets you see normally through magical and nonmagical darkness, and increases those light ranges to 40 feet each.

Name: Charlatan's Die
Description: A magical die useful for manipulating or influencing a game of chance.

Name: Charlatan's Glove
Description: A magical glove intended to assist sleight of hand and deception.

Name: Cherry Blossom Wand
Description: A wand that creates cherry-blossom-themed magical effects and blossoms.

Name: Chicken Tonic
Description: A willing drinker is polymorphed into a ceramic chicken for up to 10 minutes and can end the effect as a bonus action. It retains its mental ability scores plus skill and saving-throw proficiencies; use raven statistics, except its flying speed is halved and it falls at the end of its turn unless supported.

Name: Cleaning Cube
Description: This dehydrated 2-inch sentient cube can be placed in at least 1 gallon of water as an action, expanding into a 1-foot, 6-pound animated cleaning cube for up to 8 hours. It moves at 1 foot, can climb difficult surfaces and ceilings, and methodically cleans whatever it crosses; squeezing it as an action dehydrates it early.

Name: Cloak of Billowing
Description: A cloak that dramatically billows on command without requiring wind.

Name: Cloak of Looming
Description: A cloak that magically creates an imposing or intimidating silhouette.

Name: Cloak of Many Fashions
Description: A cloak whose color and style can be magically changed.

Name: Clockwork Amulet
Description: A clockwork amulet that can replace one attack roll with a reliable fixed result.

Name: Cloth of Instant Tables
Description: Cloth that can rapidly become a functional table for adventuring or dining.

Name: Clothes of Mending
Description: Clothing that magically repairs tears and minor damage.

Name: Companions Band
Description: A magical band that strengthens a bond between companions.

Name: Container of Heat and Frost
Description: A container that can keep contents unusually hot or cold.

Name: Copyquill
Description: A magical quill that copies written material with minimal effort.

Name: Dark Shard Amulet
Description: A dark magical amulet that can function as a spellcasting focus for a warlock.

Name: Dealmaker's Ring
Description: When making a Charisma (Deception) or Charisma (Persuasion) check involving another humanoid, you can offer a handshake and add 1d4 to the check. Once used, this property recharges at the next dawn.

Name: Diorama Die
Description: As an action, speak the die's command word and either roll it or place it with a chosen face up. It unfolds to display a miniature illusory scene whose details depend on the rolled number and how the die was cast, dropped, shaken, spun, or placed. Picking it up closes it; each activation creates a new scene.

Name: Djinn and Tonic (Common)
Description: The common potion creates a dramatic magical breeze around your hair and clothing for 1 hour. The rare version instead grants gaseous form for 10 minutes without concentration; you can end it as an action, and when you reform a burst of air forces Large or smaller creatures within 30 feet to make a DC 15 Strength save.

Name: Doodle Ring
Description: While wearing the ring, you can draw on solid surfaces with your fingertip as though using charcoal, ink, or paint in any color. The marks smudge away cleanly; the ring can maintain up to 5 square feet of drawings at once, and each mark disappears after 24 hours.

Name: Dragonmark Channel
Description: A magical focus that channels or enhances dragonmark-related magic.

Name: Dread Helm
Description: A helmet that can make the wearer's appearance frightening.

Name: Dress of Many Pockets
Description: The dress has six pockets that can be shown or hidden as a bonus action and repositioned anywhere on the dress. Each holds a parcel no larger than 4 inches in any dimension and no heavier than 2 pounds. Hidden pockets shift their contents inside the dress and distribute the weight without changing its appearance.

Name: Droplet Charm
Description: This small ceramic droplet changes expression based on humidity, impending weather, and surrounding water quality. It looks sickly in unsafe water, pleased in potable water, and looks skyward roughly 15–30 minutes before rain. Its expression takes about 6 seconds to change.

Name: Drowner's Pearl
Description: While holding the pearl in your mouth, you can survive for 1 additional minute before suffocating after running out of breath or beginning to choke underwater. After this property is used, the pearl turns to dust and is destroyed.

Name: Dryadleaf
Description: A mature leaf can be eaten as an action to let a creature speak with beasts and plants for 1 minute; picked leaves retain this magic for 7 days. The plant grows up to 4 leaves, can be repotted with a DC 15 Nature or Survival check, and regrows 1d4 missing mature leaves every 7 days if properly watered and given sunlight.

Name: Drybrooch
Description: A brooch that provides magical protection from water and dampness.

Name: Duster
Description: A magical cleaning item that removes ordinary dust and grime.

Name: Ear Horn of Hearing
Description: A magical horn that assists a creature with hearing.

Name: Electric Torch
Description: As a bonus action, pull the cord to turn the torch on, change its radius, or extinguish it. While lit it sheds bright light in a chosen 5–30 foot radius and dim light for the same distance beyond that. If you take lightning damage while carrying it, the minimum and maximum light radii double for 1 hour.

Name: Enduring Spellbook
Description: A durable spellbook magically resistant to ordinary environmental damage.

Name: Erasable Quill
Description: Any nonmagical writing or drawing made with this quill can be completely erased by brushing the marks with its feather.

Name: Ersatz Eye
Description: A magical replacement eye that functions like a natural eye.

Name: Everlasting Sugarbomb
Description: A magical candy that lasts far longer than ordinary sweets and provides a whimsical magical effect.

Name: Fanfare Ammunition
Description: When this magic arrow or bolt hits, it deals no damage and is destroyed, producing an illusory sound of your choice at the impact point. You choose a volume from a whisper to a scream; a creature can identify the sound as illusory with a DC 10 Intelligence (Investigation) check. On a miss, the ammunition remains recoverable.

Name: Featherwumpus
Description: A whimsical feather-themed magical item associated with a small fantastical creature.

Name: Firecracker Crystals
Damage: Fire damage if used as an explosive
Description: Magical crystals that create loud, bright firecracker-like bursts.

Name: Forecaster's Cloak
Description: While wearing the cloak, use an action to open it and speak its command word. For 1 minute, or until you close it, harmless sensory illusions inside the cloak depict the weather expected at your location over the next 8 hours.

Name: Fortune's Flower
Description: A magical flower associated with luck and favorable outcomes.

Name: Foxfire Charm
Description: A charm that produces foxfire-like magical illumination.

Name: Freerunner's Armor
Description: Light armor that makes the wearer unusually agile; after a long jump onto or alongside a suitable wall, the wearer can move along the wall for the length of the jump and can make another jump while there if movement remains.

Name: Frefil's Scrummy Trifection
Description: A magical sweet associated with Frefil and designed as a flavorful novelty consumable.

Name: Freshwater Pitcher
Description: A magical pitcher that provides or purifies fresh drinking water.

Name: Gardener's Candle Holder
Description: A magical candle holder designed to assist gardeners and plant growth.

Name: Ghallanda Cauldron
Description: A magical cauldron designed to assist with food preparation and hospitality.

Name: Grasping Seedling Necklace
Description: The seedling gains 1 charge each dawn, up to 7, and has one leaf per charge; it is typically found with 1d6 + 1 charges. At 7 charges, use an action to open the bauble, speak the command word, and throw the seedling to a space within 30 feet. It takes root, and each Medium or smaller creature within 5 feet must make a DC 10 Strength or Dexterity save or be grappled by the vines for 1 minute.

Name: Grass Carpet
Description: This 5-by-10-foot, 30-pound roll of magical turf is only 1 inch thick but nourishes roots as though it were 1 foot of normal soil. Plants grown in it need only half their normal sunlight and water. It takes 1 minute to roll up or unroll; folding or layering carpets increases the usable soil depth.

Name: Gravity Goblet
Description: Liquid poured into this goblet flows opposite gravity while the cup is tilted, climbing toward the rim before pouring normally once it reaches the edge. Swirling the drink makes it flow opposite the direction of rotation. Solid objects other than ice floating in the liquid are unaffected.

Name: Great Owl's Pocket Translator
Description: Choose Dwarvish, Elvish, Gnomish, or Halfling with the device's dial as a bonus action. While open, any sentence spoken within earshot in the selected language is immediately repeated by the device in Common, conveying the speaker's literal meaning.

Name: Greenthumb Whittler
Description: A magical carving tool that assists with plants, wood, and gardening.

Name: Griffon Coinpouch
Description: This 6-inch purse holds up to 1,000 coins and always weighs 1 pound regardless of contents. Coins removed from it are magically clean and shiny as if freshly minted. At the GM's discretion, an enigmatic note may occasionally be found among the coins.

Name: Griffon Key Loop
Description: Attach a key by holding it to the loop for 1 minute, storing it extradimensionally; up to 10 keys can be attached. As an action, speak the command word to make selected stored keys appear or disappear. Touching the loop to a lock whose key is stored instantly locks or unlocks it as though the key were used.

Name: Hall Decker
Description: As an action, throw this ornament at a point within 30 feet, destroying it. Roll three d20s or preset their results before throwing: the first determines how much festive décor appears, and the other two determine its themes. The decorations fill a 60-foot-radius area, spread around corners, and vanish after 7 days or when removed.

Name: Hammer of Nails
Description: As an action, speak the command word and strike an unattended object no more than 1 foot thick. It becomes magically stuck to the inanimate surface touching its opposite side until either object takes damage, a creature succeeds on a DC 10 Strength check, or sufficient force breaks the bond. Up to three objects can be held this way at once.

Name: Hat of Osnomnosis
Damage: 1d6 psychic per spell level when fed spell text
Description: This sentient wizard's hat can serve as an arcane focus. Feed it a nonmagical sheet of paper as an action to destroy the paper and immediately learn its contents as though you had read it. Magical paper is spat back out; if it contains a spell, you take 1d6 psychic damage per spell level. The hat communicates simple emotions and images telepathically while worn.

Name: Hat of Vermin
Description: A hat capable of producing small harmless vermin.

Name: Hat of Wizardry
Description: A wizardly hat that assists with minor magical tricks and spellcasting.

Name: Headband of the Sweatless
Description: While wearing the headband, perspiration still cools you but does not make you wet. The first time you make a Constitution saving throw against extreme heat, add 1d4 to the roll. This bonus recharges at the next dawn.

Name: Heart of the Sleeveless
Description: A magical item themed around sleeveless clothing and a resilient heart, providing a minor utility effect.

Name: Hedgewitch's Gardening Cane
Description: As an action while holding this staff, tap it on the ground and mentally command its lower end to transform into a broom, hoe, rake, shovel, or back into a normal cane.

Name: Heward's Handy Spice Pouch
Description: A pouch that supplies small amounts of common culinary spices.

Name: Horn of Silent Alarm
Description: A horn that can sound an alarm audible only to designated creatures.

Name: House Slipper Socks
Description: While wearing these knitted socks, use an action to wipe your shoes as though on a doormat. Your shoes, socks, and feet are then magically cleaned, dried, and freed of dirt and grime.

Name: Immovable Button
Description: A magical button that becomes fixed in place and can be used as a tiny anchor.

Name: Inker's Armband
Description: A magical armband that assists with ink, writing, and drawing.

Name: Instigator's Rod
Description: A magical rod intended to provoke, encourage, or manipulate creatures into taking action.

Name: Instrument of Illusions
Description: A musical instrument capable of producing harmless illusory effects.

Name: Instrument of Scribing
Description: A magical instrument that assists with writing and transcription.

Name: Integrated Tool
Description: A magical tool incorporated into an object so it is always ready for use.

Name: Intrepid Knife
Description: A magically courageous knife designed to aid a daring wielder in dangerous situations.

Name: Journal of Dreams
Description: A magical journal associated with recording, influencing, or remembering dreams.

Name: LampLighter
Description: A magical utility item for lighting lamps and other small light sources.

Name: Leaf Carver
Description: When this jade dagger is used as part of an Intelligence (Nature), Wisdom (Survival), or herbalism-kit check, you can add 1d4 to the roll. Once used, this property recharges at the next dawn. If the added d4 rolls a 4, the knife also produces one goodberry.

Name: Leatherbeard
Description: Wear or remove this leather mask as an action. While worn, it creates an illusory beard of your chosen color and style up to 2 feet long; a DC 10 Intelligence (Investigation) check reveals the illusion. For each 7 consecutive days you keep it on, there is a cumulative 25% chance the beard becomes real and the mask is destroyed.

Name: Light Sling
Description: As an action, speak the command word and hurl a ball of light at a point or target within 30 feet. It sheds bright light for 20 feet and dim light for 20 more. On a hit it deals no damage and sticks for up to 1 minute; an unwilling creature or carried object can avoid it with a DC 10 Dexterity save, and a nearby creature can snuff it out as an action.

Name: Living Wig (Common)
Description: While worn, you can mentally change the wig's hairstyle and color over 1 minute, including connected facial hair. It can produce real-looking hair from 1/4 inch to 3 feet long; cut hair immediately turns to ash. Putting on or removing the wig takes an action, and it returns to its normal form when removed.

Name: Lock of Trickery
Description: A magical lock designed to complicate attempts to open or bypass it.

Name: Magnificent Pocket Vanity
Description: This palm-sized vanity has 3 uses. As an action, expend 1 use to apply magical makeup to yourself or a willing creature within reach, producing a random disguise-self-style appearance (save DC 13). The illusion can visually change apparent height by up to 5 feet without changing size. After the third use, the vanity becomes nonmagical.

Name: Manifold Tool
Description: A magical tool capable of taking several useful tool forms.

Name: Mask of Changed Appearance
Description: A mask that magically alters the wearer's visible appearance.

Name: Mask of the Crocodile
Description: A crocodile-themed magical mask associated with aquatic or reptilian abilities.

Name: Mechanical Wonder (Common)
Description: A small magical mechanical device intended for useful practical tasks.

Name: Merry Berry
Description: A magical fruit whose cooked form enhances smell and taste-related checks and cooking ability for a time.

Name: Mimic's Smilemaker
Description: Brush your teeth with this magical toothbrush for 1 minute to clean them exceptionally well and freshen your breath. Your teeth then transform into fangs and your tongue becomes blue-purple until you finish a long rest.

Name: Miraculous Bread Box
Description: A magical bread container that preserves or produces useful bread-related effects.

Name: Moon-Touched Sword
Description: A sword that sheds a soft moonlike magical light.

Name: Mysterious Potion
Description: After drinking this potion, you give off an uncanny air of mystery for 1d4 hours, making other creatures more likely to become suspicious of or intrigued by you; the exact roleplaying effect is left to the GM.

Name: Mystery Key
Description: A magical key that can potentially fit and open an otherwise unknown lock.

Name: Mythallar Bracelet
Description: A magical bracelet associated with the arcane power of mythallars.

Name: Neutralizing Spray
Description: As an action, spray a 5-foot cube within 5 feet. Creatures and objects in the area are magically cleaned as by prestidigitation, and any remaining odor is suppressed for 10 minutes. The bottle has 4 uses and refills at dawn; after expending the last use, roll a d4, and on a 1 it permanently stops replenishing.

Name: Oaken Candle
Description: Light this bark-like candle as an action. Its green flame sheds 5 feet of bright light plus 5 feet of dim light. After burning for 1d8 + 4 hours, it is destroyed and, if placed on solid ground with enough room, grows into an oak tree up to 30 feet tall over 10 minutes.

Name: Oil of Tattoos
Description: The flask contains 5 applications. Spend 1 minute applying the oil to a willing creature to create a permanent tattoo of your chosen design. A small tattoo costs 1 application, medium 2, and large 3. The tattoo remains until removed by dispel magic or similar magic.

Name: Orators Quill
Description: A magical quill that assists with speeches, writing, or persuasive communication.

Name: Orb of Direction
Description: A magical orb that assists with determining direction.

Name: Orb of Remembrance
Description: As an action, speak the orb's command word to prime it for 1 minute. While primed, squeeze it to capture the surrounding area in a 30-foot radius as a miniature illusory diorama; after 1 minute the orb clears and the scene inside silently replays the next 6 seconds after the captured moment.

Name: Orb of Time
Description: A magical orb that helps track or indicate the passage of time.

Name: Orostead Iced Tea
Description: A magical specialty beverage associated with Orostead and designed primarily as a flavorful utility or social item.

Name: Owl Helm
Description: An owl-themed magical helm that improves awareness or provides an owl-related benefit.

Name: Owlbear Snugglebeast
Description: A magical stuffed owlbear companion designed for comfort and whimsical utility.

Name: Pair of Tiny Violin Rings
Description: A paired set of rings with a tiny violin theme and a magical performance-oriented effect.

Name: Patch of the Mallard
Description: A magical patch depicting a mallard that provides a minor duck-themed effect.

Name: Patch of the Open Eye
Description: After attaching the patch for 1 minute, you can't be surprised while wearing it; when it prevents you from being surprised, it falls off and becomes mundane. Alternatively, after making a Perception check but before learning the result, you can remove it to add 1d4 to the check.

Name: Patch of the Pail
Description: A magical patch with a pail motif that provides a minor utility effect.

Name: Patch of the Tome
Description: A magical patch themed around books and spellbooks.

Name: Performers Puppet
Description: A magical puppet designed to assist with performances and entertainment.

Name: Perfume of Bewitching
Description: Magical perfume that makes its wearer more alluring and socially persuasive.

Name: Periscope Rod
Description: While holding this rod to your eye, you can speak its command word to see through the far end as though using a spyglass. As a bonus action you can change the rod's angle and extend or shorten it up to 5 feet; it retracts when removed from your eye.

Name: Permanent Parchment
Description: As a bonus action, you can lock or unlock the parchment. While locked, it can't be damaged by nonmagical means, existing nonmagical writing can't be altered, and new nonmagical ink runs off it; speaking its clearing command erases the writing.

Name: Phantom Walkers
Description: These boots increase the DC to track you by your footprints by 5. Once per day, as a bonus action, you can suppress your own tracks for 1 minute while creating a false trail that can extend up to 300 feet and lasts 8 hours; a DC 13 Arcana check identifies it as magical.

Name: Pipe of Delicious Smells
Description: While smoking the empty pipe, you can use an action to exhale a puff of smoke that smells like a food of your choice. The aroma lingers only for a few seconds.

Name: Pipe of Smoke Monsters
Description: A pipe that produces harmless smoke shapes resembling creatures.

Name: Pole of Angling
Description: A magical fishing pole that assists with catching fish.

Name: Pole of Collapsing
Description: A pole that magically collapses to a compact size for carrying.

Name: Pollen Pipe
Description: Smoking this otherwise empty pipe produces aromatic pollen instead of normal smoke. Flowers within 10 feet bloom and turn toward the pipe while it is being smoked.

Name: Poltergeist Candle Holder
Description: While it holds a candle, you can use a bonus action and command word to make this holder hover over your shoulder and follow you. A lit candle's smoke hangs unnaturally still for about 6 seconds before dissipating.

Name: Pomade of Ten Thousand Styles
Description: Magical hair pomade that lets the user dramatically alter hairstyle and appearance.

Name: Pop-Up Business Card
Description: A magical business card that can create a convenient miniature presentation or contact display.

Name: Portable HEarth
Description: As an action, place this 4-inch disk on a flat surface and set its dial to warm the surrounding area by up to 50°F, never above 80°F. You choose a radius up to 30 feet, with walls and ceilings blocking the effect; the temperature changes over 1 minute.

Name: Pot of Awakening
Description: A magical pot capable of awakening a plant into a simple sentient creature.

Name: Potion of Climbing
Description: A potion that grants enhanced climbing ability for a limited duration.

Name: Potion of Comprehension
Description: A potion that magically assists the drinker in understanding written languages.

Name: Potion of Healing (Common)
Description: A restorative potion that magically restores hit points.

Name: Profane Mask
Description: While worn over your mouth, ordinary words you speak are heard by others as obscenities, though you hear yourself normally. A DC 10 Investigation or Insight check can reveal the distortion; verbal spell components, command words, and actual curses are unaffected.

Name: Prosthetic Limb
Description: A magical replacement limb that functions much like the natural limb it replaces.

Name: Quicksilver Clay
Description: This 1-inch orb of silvery liquid can be reshaped in your palm as an action into any form no larger than your hand. It remains liquid, holds the chosen shape while you concentrate on it, and returns to an orb when your focus ends or it leaves your hand.

Name: Quill of Chicken Scratch
Description: A humorous magical quill that produces intentionally chicken-scratch-like writing.

Name: Radiant Teapot
Damage: Potentially radiant if used offensively; primarily utility
Description: A magical teapot associated with warm radiant light and tea.

Name: Redsmith Carrying Pack
Description: A magical pack designed to make carrying smithing tools and materials easier.

Name: Redsmith Crucible Set
Description: A magical metalworking crucible set that assists with smithing and crafting.

Name: Redsmith Hammer
Description: A magical smithing hammer that assists with metalworking and crafting.

Name: Ring of Busy Hands
Description: While wearing this ring, you can choose to create a Tiny, obviously magical illusion around your hand whenever you make a recognizable hand gesture, such as conjuring an illusory hat when tipping one or a cup when miming a drink.

Name: Ring of Busy Hands
Description: While wearing this ring, you can choose to create a Tiny, obviously magical illusion around your hand whenever you make a recognizable hand gesture, such as conjuring an illusory hat when tipping one or a cup when miming a drink.

Name: Ring of Gestures
Description: A magical ring designed to enhance or communicate gestures through minor magical effects.

Name: Ring of Names
Description: When you shake hands with a humanoid, you can make an Insight check contested by its Deception check. On a success, you magically learn the name it would give a casual acquaintance and that name appears on the ring's inner parchment. Once successful, this property recharges at dawn.

Name: Ring of Perching
Description: As an action, hold the ring-bearing finger aloft and whistle its command melody to call the nearest harmless Tiny bird within 60 feet to perch on it. You gain +1d4 to Animal Handling checks made to interact with a bird perched this way.

Name: Ring of Roses
Description: A magical ring associated with roses and capable of producing a minor floral effect.

Name: Ring of Silverware
Description: As a bonus action while wearing this ring, you can mentally transform it into a fork, spoon, or another harmless cook's utensil such as a ladle or spatula. It returns to ring form when you mentally end the effect or stop holding it.

Name: Ring of the Candle Keeper
Description: A magical ring designed to assist with carrying, maintaining, or magically tending candles and small flames.

Name: Ring of the Distant Digit
Description: As an action while wearing this ring, you can make the finger bearing it become ghostly and create a magical duplicate finger that pokes, presses, or taps something you can see within 30 feet; the duplicate then vanishes and your finger returns to normal.

Name: Ring of the Fowl Sentinel
Description: A magical ring themed around birds that provides a minor bird- or watchfulness-related benefit.

Name: Ring of the Printless
Description: While wearing this ring, your hands leave no fingerprints or natural skin oil on objects you touch.

Name: Rings of the Secret Scribe
Description: This pair functions only on adjacent fingers. While pinching those fingers together as if writing, you can magically write on any surface within 1 inch of them, producing ordinary ink in a color of your choice.

Name: Rival Coin
Description: A magical coin associated with a rival or paired object and useful for a minor magical connection.

Name: Rod of Endless Light
Description: As an action while holding the rod, speak its command word to make it shed bright light for 20 feet and dim light for another 20 feet for up to 1 hour. You can end it with the command word and change the light's color as a bonus action.

Name: Rope Caster
Description: This hand crossbow is loaded with rope as a bonus action. A ranged attack can fire the rope at a willing creature or unattended object; on a hit it deals no damage and magically loops and securely ties the rope around the target, forming a harmless harness on a willing creature.

Name: Rope Cobra
Description: As an action, animate this 30-foot rope into a cobra for up to 1 minute; you can command it each turn. It has AC 11, 2 HP, resistance to all damage, speed 30 feet, climb speed 15 feet on non-smooth surfaces, 30-foot blindsight, and escape DC 10. It can't attack and recharges at dawn.

Name: Rope of Mending
Description: A rope that magically repairs itself when damaged or severed.

Name: Rose Quartz Koi
Description: When placed underwater, this Tiny 2-pound crystal fish animates and swims within a 5-foot cube. In a saltwater container no larger than 5 feet on a side, it turns the water fresh after 10 minutes; you can recapture it as an action.

Name: Ruby of the War Mage
Description: A ruby that allows a weapon to be used as a spellcasting focus.

Name: Scarring Axe
Description: A magical axe associated with wounds and scars, providing an additional scar-forming magical effect on its attacks.

Name: Scroll of Exclamation
Description: A magical communication scroll that amplifies written words when read aloud, projecting them clearly over a long distance.

Name: Scroll of Film
Description: A magical scroll associated with recording or displaying images and scenes like a strip of film.

Name: Scroll of Instant Cookies
Description: A scroll that turns pressed sections of parchment into freshly baked cookies; each foot produces a batch, and the remaining rolling pin functions as a magical club.

Name: Scroll of Miraculous Mail
Description: A magical scroll used to send or receive messages through supernatural mail-like transportation.

Name: Seat Belt
Description: A magical belt that secures a rider or wearer and helps prevent falls.

Name: Sensory Snifter
Description: A magical drinking vessel designed to enhance or alter sensory experiences associated with its contents.

Name: Sentry Candle
Description: A candle that can act as a magical lookout or warning device.

Name: Shapeshifters Circlet
Description: A magical circlet associated with changing or disguising physical appearance.

Name: Shield of Expression
Description: A shield whose face can magically display different expressions.

Name: Shifter's Shine (Common)
Description: A magical beverage that temporarily improves the drinker's appearance and lets the drinker treat one Charisma check as a 10; an uncommon version also grants alter self for a limited time.

Name: Shimmering Spectacles
Description: Magical spectacles that produce a shimmering appearance while assisting sight or observation.

Name: Shipwright's Watch
Description: A magical watch designed to assist shipwrights and maritime work.

Name: Silver Coin of Duvra
Description: A magical silver coin associated with Duvra and a whimsical social or luck-based effect.

Name: Silver Star Cane
Damage: Weapon damage if used as a cane weapon
Description: A silvered magical cane with a star-themed utility or defensive effect.

Name: Silvered Weapon
Description: A weapon treated with magical silver for overcoming certain creature resistances.

Name: Singing Stein
Description: A magical drinking stein that can sing or produce musical effects.

Name: Sleepytime Sheep Stuffy
Description: A magical stuffed sheep that helps with sleep and comfort.

Name: Smash Potatoes
Damage: Bludgeoning if used as an improvised thrown food/object
Description: A magical potato-themed novelty item with a playful smashing effect.

Name: Smoldering Armor
Description: Armor that continually gives off harmless smoke, embers, and a smoldering appearance.

Name: Snake Oil (Common)
Description: A humorous magical potion associated with exaggerated salesmanship and deceptive claims, providing a minor supernatural benefit.

Name: Snow Rider's Sleigh
Description: A magical sleigh designed to travel efficiently across snow and icy terrain.

Name: Snowball Mittens
Damage: Cold/bludgeoning damage if used to create magical snowball attacks
Description: Magical mittens that assist with making and throwing snowballs.

Name: Spark
Description: A tiny magical source of sparks useful for creating a small flame or ignition.

Name: Spell Scroll (Common)
Description: This scroll contains a single spell. A creature with that spell on its class spell list can attempt to cast it from the scroll, using the scroll's fixed spell attack bonus and save DC; the writing disappears after a successful casting.

Name: Spool of Shadow
Description: A magical spool containing shadowy thread useful for concealment and trickery.

Name: Staff of Adornment
Description: A staff that creates small decorative magical effects.

Name: Staff of Birdcalls
Description: A staff capable of producing convincing bird calls.

Name: Staff of Flowers
Description: A staff capable of producing harmless flowers and floral effects.

Name: Stalwart Staff
Damage: None beyond its normal weapon damage
Description: A dependable magical staff intended to improve the user's resilience or defensive capability.

Name: Stamp of Shipping
Description: A magical stamp that assists with preparing packages and shipping objects.

Name: Starlight Lamp
Description: A lamp that produces gentle starlight-like illumination.

Name: Status Signets
Description: Paired rings that let wearers within 100 feet magically sense one another's current hit points and condition.

Name: Steps of the Trickster
Description: Magical footwear or steps that provide a trickster-themed movement or positioning benefit.

Name: Stick of Shaking
Description: A magical stick that produces a shaking or vibrating effect for humorous or utility purposes.

Name: Storm Seer Lamp
Description: A magical lamp that helps sense or display approaching storms.

Name: Storyteller's Stein
Description: A magical drinking stein associated with storytelling and entertainment.

Name: Stylists Circlet
Description: A magical circlet that assists with changing or improving hairstyles and personal appearance.

Name: Sun and Moon Shield
Description: A shield decorated with living sun and moon imagery that can shed bright light for 20 feet and dim light for another 20 feet for up to 1 hour; the light changes between warm and cool tones with the time of day.

Name: Sylvan Talon
Description: A claw-shaped magical item associated with sylvan or fey magic.

Name: Talking Doll
Description: A magical doll capable of speaking or communicating messages.

Name: Talking Wand
Description: A wand capable of magical speech or communication.

Name: Tankard of Sobriety
Description: A magical tankard that suppresses the normal effects of intoxication.

Name: Tea Weird
Description: A strange magical tea with an unusual supernatural effect.

Name: Tear of Gaia
Description: A magical tear-shaped item associated with nature, earth, and the living world.

Name: Thurimbar Rod
Description: A magical rod associated with Thurimbar and useful for arcane purposes.

Name: Tide Turner
Description: A magical item associated with changing tides and manipulating water.

Name: Torpedo Arrow
Damage: Normal arrow damage with an enhanced forceful/propulsive effect
Description: An arrow designed to launch toward its target with exceptional speed and impact.

Name: Tote of Tricky Treat Sugarbombs
Description: A magical bag of sweets that produces playful candy-themed effects.

Name: Turtle Brooch
Description: A turtle-themed brooch that provides a minor defensive or aquatic benefit.

Name: Uorik Juice Cup
Description: A magical cup associated with Uorik and a whimsical beverage-related effect.

Name: Uul'kur
Description: A mysterious magical item associated with an unusual supernatural power.

Name: Veteran's Cane
Description: A magical cane with a concealed adventuring or weapon-related function.

Name: Vial of Snail Slime
Description: A vial containing magical snail slime useful for lubrication, movement, or sticky utility.

Name: Vial Ring
Description: A ring containing or concealing a tiny vial, designed for carrying a small amount of liquid or magical substance.

Name: Vineyard Amulet
Description: A magical amulet associated with vineyards, grapes, and plant growth.

Name: Vola'khesh
Description: A magical item associated with the Vola'khesh and its arcane tradition.

Name: Vox Helm
Description: A magical helm associated with voice, speech, and communication.

Name: Walking Pot
Description: A magical plant pot capable of moving about on its own.

Name: Walloping Ammunition
Description: Ammunition enchanted to knock targets off balance; on a successful hit it can force a target prone.

Name: Wand of Bubbles
Description: A wand that creates harmless bubbles and bubbly magical effects.

Name: Wand of Conducting
Description: A wand that assists with musical direction and performance.

Name: Wand of Pyrotechnics
Description: A wand that produces bright, colorful, harmless pyrotechnic displays.

Name: Wand of Torchlight
Description: A wand that produces a portable magical torchlight effect.

Name: War Staff
Description: A staff designed to serve as a dependable magical or martial implement.

Name: Waterwine Goblet
Description: A magical goblet associated with transforming, purifying, or enhancing water and wine.

Name: Weapon of Showmanship
Description: A flashy magical weapon that produces theatrical effects designed to make its wielder's attacks and performances more dramatic.

Name: Webgrip Rucksack
Description: A magical backpack that uses spiderweb-like grip or webbing to secure its contents and assist climbing.

Name: Whispergust Mote
Description: A tiny magical mote that produces whispers or small gusts of air.

Name: Widemouth Bucket
Description: A magical bucket with an unusually wide opening that makes collecting and transporting materials easier.

Name: Williwig's Time Stopper
Description: A magical time-themed item that can briefly interfere with or pause the passage of time.

Name: Winner's Trophy
Description: A magical trophy that provides a small benefit associated with victory and competition.

Name: Wispy Sour (Common)
Description: A magical drink that lets the user hover slightly above the ground for a short time; a stronger version can also restore hit points when the drinker drops hostile creatures to 0 hit points.

Name: Wizards' Bout Top
Description: A magical spinning top themed around wizardly contests and arcane play.

Name: Worker's Wondrous Ladder
Description: A magical ladder designed to assist workers by changing or adapting its length and placement.
